comments.body:
how to repeat getting this map?
After I discover Marble Table, this map wont pop up again

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Report this discovery to an NPC (Archive Maps section on this DB lists NPCs who like Treasure discoveries if you want a QMP but it isn't required). The map becomes available from archives and you can rediscover it.

Additionally, it is possible to create certain ornaments which require this card; however, the card will be removed from your inventory in the process after crafting a single ornament and you must report and rediscover the map to get the card again for further use in ornaments.

comments.author: Morro
comments.body: Check that you don't have the Oxford skill activated that avoids getting maps you've already completed. Also, if you want, spend the discovery card for marble table using it to make an ornament at a craftsman.
